name: @cutenode/post-together
description: Post Markdown files from a directory to Bluesky, as a GitHub Action, a Tangled Spindle step, or a CLI.
author: Tierney Cyren

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:action
scripts.build:action: esbuild src/action.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/action.js --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check-dist: npm run build:action && git diff --exit-code -- dist/action.js
